careers.name: Geomatics and survey engineer
careers.about: Maps land, roads, tunnels and hydropower sites using GPS, drones, total stations and GIS. High demand in municipalities, land offices and infrastructure projects.

careers.name: Electronics and telecom engineer
careers.about: Works on telecom networks, fiber, embedded hardware, automation and broadcasting for ISPs, Nepal Telecom, Ncell and tech firms.

careers.name: Biomedical and clinical engineer
careers.about: Installs, calibrates and maintains hospital imaging, ICU, lab and surgical machines for hospitals and medical suppliers.

careers.name: Optometrist and vision specialist
careers.about: Examines eyes, prescribes lenses and detects eye disease early. Nepal's famous eye hospitals and private optical clinics hire steadily.

careers.name: Radiographer and imaging technologist
careers.about: Operates X-ray, CT, MRI and ultrasound equipment in hospitals and diagnostic centres alongside radiologists.

careers.name: Ayurvedic physician and medical officer
careers.about: Practises integrated Ayurvedic and preventive medicine in government Ayurveda hospitals, dispensaries, wellness resorts and herbal pharma.

careers.name: Microbiologist and biotechnologist
careers.about: Tests clinical samples, water, food and pharmaceuticals, and runs molecular diagnostics and fermentation labs.

careers.name: Geologist and hydrogeologist
careers.about: Studies rock stability, tunnels, landslides, mines and groundwater for hydropower projects, road departments and disaster agencies.

careers.name: IT business analyst and product manager
careers.about: Bridges software teams, banking operations and users by turning business needs into digital products and workflows.

careers.name: Tax, audit and compliance specialist
careers.about: Handles statutory audits, VAT and income tax filings, internal control and financial advisory for firms and banks.

routes.name: Pre-Diploma (TSLC, 18 months, CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE appeared or Class 10 / basic trade entry as per CTEVT notice
routes.about: Practical 18-month training (formerly TSLC) in civil sub-overseer, electrical, mechanical, computer, JTA agriculture, livestock and ANM. Subsidised seats at public polytechnics cost very little and qualify for Junior Technical Assistant jobs or lateral entry to a 3-year diploma.
routes.exam: CTEVT Pre-Diploma entrance and skill test

routes.name: Sanskrit, Gurukul, Gumba and Madrasa stream
routes.entry: Passed Class 8 in a recognised traditional or mainstream school
routes.about: Mainstreamed Gurukul (Sanskrit Vyakarana, Sahitya, Jyotish), Buddhist Gumba (Bhot language and philosophy) and Madrasa schools teach classical languages and philosophy alongside compulsory English, Maths, Nepali and Science for SEE and +2.
routes.exam: SEE and NEB Class 12 board exams

routes.name: PCL Nursing (Staff Nurse, CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with at least GPA 2.0 and C grades in English, Maths and Science
routes.about: Three-year Proficiency Certificate Level in Nursing. CTEVT sets the full-fee tuition cap at NPR 4.75 lakh, with classified full-scholarship seats in every intake. Graduates sit the Nepal Nursing Council exam, work as Staff Nurses in hospitals, and can study BNS later.
routes.exam: CTEVT PCL entrance, then Nepal Nursing Council licence exam

routes.name: PCL in General Medicine (Health Assistant / HA)
routes.entry: SEE with at least GPA 2.0 and C grades in English, Maths and Science
routes.about: Trains Health Assistants who run municipal health posts, emergency outpatient units and primary care clinics across Nepal. CTEVT fixes the full-fee cap at NPR 4.04 lakh, while constituent schools charge around NPR 49k to 1.3 lakh. Registration with NHPC is required.
routes.exam: CTEVT PCL entrance, then NHPC registration

routes.name: Diploma in Pharmacy (CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with at least GPA 2.0 and C grades in English, Maths and Science
routes.about: Prepares Pharmacy Assistants for hospital dispensaries, community pharmacies and drug distribution. CTEVT fixes the full-fee tuition ceiling at NPR 3.378 lakh, and graduates sit the Nepal Pharmacy Council licensure exam.
routes.exam: CTEVT entrance, then Nepal Pharmacy Council licence exam

routes.name: Diploma in Geomatics (Survey Engineering, CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with minimum required grades in Maths and Science
routes.about: Three-year land surveying and mapping diploma (Amin / Surveyor). Graduates work in land revenue (Napi) offices, municipalities, road and hydropower construction, or continue to BE Geomatics.
routes.exam: CTEVT entrance and board exams

routes.name: Diploma in Forestry (CTEVT / IOF)
routes.entry: SEE with required grades in Science and Maths
routes.about: Trains forest rangers in silviculture, wildlife conservation, watershed management and community forestry. Opens Ranger level posts in the forest service via Lok Sewa and progression to BSc Forestry.
routes.exam: CTEVT or IOF entrance

routes.name: Diploma in Computer or Information Technology (CTEVT)
routes.entry: SEE with required grades in Maths and Science
routes.about: Three-year technical diploma covering programming, web development, computer networks, database systems and hardware maintenance. Graduates can enter tech jobs early or join BE Computer, BIT or BCA.
routes.exam: CTEVT entrance and semester board exams

routes.name: BIM (Bachelor of Information Management)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream with at least D+ / 1.8 CGPA
routes.about: Tribhuvan University Faculty of Management degree combining roughly 60% computing (Java, Python, web, databases, AI, networking) and 40% management (accounting, economics, finance). Public campuses charge around NPR 3 to 4 lakh; private colleges charge NPR 5 to 8 lakh.
routes.exam: CMAT (Central Management Admission Test) conducted by TU FoM

routes.name: BBM (Bachelor of Business Management)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream with at least D+ / 1.8 CGPA
routes.about: Semester-based TU management degree focused on entrepreneurship, banking operations, financial management and leadership, with focus-area electives and an internship.
routes.exam: CMAT conducted by TU Faculty of Management

routes.name: BBA-BI / BBA Finance (Banking and Insurance)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream meeting the university GPA bar
routes.about: Specialised business bachelor under Pokhara University and TU tailored to commercial banking, risk management, treasury, microfinance, life and non-life insurance and capital markets.
routes.exam: Pokhara University entrance or TU CMAT

routes.name: BNS / PBBN (Bachelor of Nursing Science)
routes.entry: PCL Nursing passed with Nepal Nursing Council licence and clinical experience as per MEC rules
routes.about: Three-year bachelor upgrade route specifically for PCL Staff Nurses. MEC fixes the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 5.18 lakh (half the BSc Nursing tuition), with 75% scholarship seats in public health academies via MECEE-BL.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BAMS (Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery)
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) or Ayurvedic certificate with at least 50% / 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Integrates classical Ayurvedic medicine (Kayachikitsa, Shalya, Dravyaguna, Panchakarma) with modern anatomy, physiology, pathology and pharmacology. MEC sets the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 11.32 lakh, with scholarship seats at TU Ayurveda Campus Kirtipur.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BOptom (Bachelor of Optometry)
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) or Ophthalmic Science diploma with 50% / 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Four-year clinical eye-care degree covering refraction, contact lenses, low vision, binocular vision and ocular disease screening. MEC sets the paying tuition cap at NPR 7.77 lakh.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BSc MIT (Medical Imaging Technology)
routes.entry: +2 Science (PCB) or Radiography diploma with 50% / 2.4 CGPA
routes.about: Trains diagnostic imaging technologists in digital X-ray, CT scan, MRI, mammography, fluoroscopy and interventional radiology. MEC sets the paying tuition ceiling at NPR 7.77 lakh.
routes.exam: MECEE-BL conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: BE Geomatics Engineering
routes.entry: +2 Science (Physical) or Geomatics / Civil diploma
routes.about: Covers satellite positioning (GNSS), photogrammetry, LiDAR, GIS, remote sensing and land administration. Taught at KU Dhulikhel (with Land Management Ministry scholarships) and IOE Paschimanchal Campus Pokhara.
routes.exam: IOE entrance or KUEE

routes.name: BE Electronics, Communication and Information Engineering
routes.entry: +2 Science (Physical) or Electronics / Computer diploma
routes.about: Combines digital electronics, embedded systems, telecommunications, signal processing and computer networks with software engineering. Graduates work in both telecom/hardware and software companies.
routes.exam: IOE entrance, KUEE or university entrance

routes.name: BE Aerospace, Automobile or Industrial Engineering
routes.entry: +2 Science (Physical) or Mechanical / Auto diploma
routes.about: Specialised IOE constituent programmes: Aerospace and Chemical Engineering run at Pulchowk, Industrial Engineering at Thapathali, and Automobile Engineering at Thapathali and Paschimanchal Pokhara.
routes.exam: IOE entrance (TU)

routes.name: BE Biomedical Engineering
routes.entry: +2 Science with Physics, Chemistry and Maths (or Biology bridge)
routes.about: Applies electronics, sensors, software and mechanics to medical equipment, prosthetics and hospital clinical engineering.
routes.exam: Purbanchal University or college entrance

routes.name: BSc Microbiology or Biotechnology
routes.entry: +2 Science (Biology)
routes.about: Focuses on medical, food, agricultural and environmental microbiology, genetics and molecular biology. Public TU campuses charge low fees; graduates work in pathology labs, pharma, breweries, dairy and research institutes.
routes.exam: TU IOST, KU or Purbanchal entrance

routes.name: BSc Geology
routes.entry: +2 Science
routes.about: Earth materials, structural geology, hydrogeology and engineering geology. Taught at TU campuses such as Tri-Chandra, Prithvi Narayan Pokhara and Birendra Chitwan, with strong field camp training for hydropower and tunnel projects.
routes.exam: TU IOST entrance

routes.name: BA LLB / BBA LLB (5-year Integrated Law)
routes.entry: +2 in any stream
routes.about: Direct five-year integrated law degree after +2 combining political science, economics, sociology or management with constitutional, criminal, corporate and international law, moot courts and legal aid clinics.
routes.exam: Law entrance exam (TU FoL, KUSoL, PU, PoU, FWU or MWU)

routes.name: BPA (Public Administration) / Development Studies
routes.entry: +2 in any stream
routes.about: Public policy, local government finance,administrative law, human resource management and development planning. Directly aligned with the Lok Sewa officer syllabus and NGO programme management.
routes.exam: TU CMAT or university entrance

routes.name: Regulated language and skill routes (EPS Korea, SSW Japan)
routes.entry: Age 18+, SEE or +2, medical fitness and clean record
routes.about: Government-to-government employment and vocational study-work paths such as South Korea's EPS-TOPIK (manufacturing and agriculture) and Japan's Specified Skilled Worker (SSW, requiring JLPT N4 / JFT-Basic plus a sector skill test in caregiving, food service, agriculture or construction). Apply only through official government portals (EOE / DoFE and Prometric) to avoid fraud.
routes.exam: EPS-TOPIK or JLPT N4 / JFT-Basic plus sector skill test

routes.name: MPA (Master of Public Administration) / Public Policy
routes.entry: Bachelor degree in any discipline
routes.about: Postgraduate study in public policy, development administration, federalism, public budgeting and governance. Popular among civil servants, NGO managers and officer candidates.
routes.exam: TU FoM / CDPA entrance test

routes.name: MDS (Master of Dental Surgery)
routes.entry: BDS degree, Nepal Medical Council registration and 1 year clinical experience as per MEC notice
routes.about: Specialist dental residency in orthodontics, oral and maxillofacial surgery, prosthodontics, conservative dentistry, periodontics or pedodontics. Public seats carry a government scholarship and service bond.
routes.exam: MECEE-PG conducted by the Medical Education Commission

routes.name: MPhil (Master of Philosophy)
routes.entry: Master degree in the relevant subject with required CGPA
routes.about: Research methodology, advanced seminars and a dissertation that bridge a Master degree and a PhD. Offered by TU, KU, NOU and PU in education, management, English, economics, mathematics and public administration.
routes.exam: University research entrance and interview

routes.name: Professional Council Licensure (NEC, NMC, NNC, NPC, NHPC, Bar)
routes.entry: Recognised bachelor or diploma in engineering, medicine, nursing, pharmacy, allied health or law
routes.about: Graduates in regulated professions must pass their statutory council exam before practising in Nepal or sitting government service exams: Nepal Engineering Council (NEC), Nepal Medical Council (NMC), Nepal Nursing Council (NNC), Nepal Pharmacy Council (NPC), Nepal Health Professional Council (NHPC) and Nepal Bar Council.
routes.exam: Council licensing examination (computer-based or written MCQ)
